evidence_span: I do not know why, Mindy, you are doing this
review_note: Reasons for Mindy acting; no denial of killing.

evidence_span: I don't understand why I did it.
review_note: Negation concerns understanding; it remains unresolved.

evidence_span: I didn't know what happened.
review_note: Unknown event circumstances; does not establish accident.

evidence_span: I don’t know what to say to you
review_note: Speech-planning formula, kept as an explicit contrast. Neither this nor no words to say establishes knowledge of a killing.

evidence_span: forgive me for taking his life
review_note: Background self-attribution retained (previously presupposed). Self-attribution embedded in forgiveness request, not a standalone assertion.

evidence_span: I don't know who you are.
review_note: Knowledge of addressee identity.

evidence_span: I hurt a lot of people with decisions I made.
review_note: Harm attributed to own decisions; killing not specified.

evidence_span: I don't know if you believe me
review_note: Outer knowledge holder is self; embedded belief holder is listener.

evidence_span: I take the full blame for this.
review_note: Responsibility acceptance; this does not specify a physical act.

evidence_span: Texas has executed innocent people
review_note: General claim about executions; not explicit personal innocence.

evidence_span: you executed an innocent man
review_note: Owner confirmed presented_as_true under v3; anticipated execution treated as settled expectation. Earlier nonasserted/provisional decisions retained in history.

evidence_span: anyone who would of killed my children
review_note: Hypothetical killing predicate has positive polarity. Outer inability to forgive does not negate killing; children are speaker's.

evidence_span: they call me a cold-blooded killer
review_note: Attributed killer characterization, not a specified action proposition. Killing-related agent nouns enter retrieval/contrast review but do not automatically become action claims.

evidence_span: I shot a man that shot me first.
review_note: Affirmed shooting; when links it to previous attributed characterization. Opponent shot first is speaker's claim, not verified; death not explicit.

evidence_span: I continue to say I am innocent.
review_note: Affirmed innocence status, retained as other rather than miscast as an action denial.

evidence_span: a crime I did not commit
review_note: Crime unspecified in text; do not silently replace crime with killing.

evidence_span: I don’t know why Marta Glass wasn’t allowed in here.
review_note: Knowledge of visitor admission reasons.

evidence_span: They are taking the life of an innocent man.
review_note: Taking life described as ongoing execution. Innocent man is contextually identified with speaker; not explicit first-person naming.

evidence_span: I know you think I did this
review_note: Selected embedded attributed action claim; source listener, actor speaker. Surrounding I know supplies attribution context; no separate knowledge row is required for every enclosing verb.

evidence_span: Three people at different times confessed to killing these people
review_note: Confession attributed to three others. Narrator presents the report; endorsement of truth is not separately inferred.

evidence_span: They did not know me.
review_note: Acquaintance predicate, holder not speaker. They may refer to confessors or victims; precise identity unresolved, but both possible groups are other.

evidence_span: I did not kill anyone in my life.
review_note: Explicit personal killing denial.

evidence_span: Warden, murder me.
review_note: Positive imperative predicate addressed to Warden. Not assertion that murder occurred; execution framed as murder.

evidence_span: I was responsible for the ’75 and ’79 cases.
review_note: Case responsibility accepted; role and specific action not supplied.

evidence_span: whose lives were not taken by me
review_note: Denial concerns named relatives; relative-clause attachment may include all relatives or only sister. Relation to conviction unknown.

evidence_span: I did this, I chose this
review_note: Unresolved this; do not convert into killing admission.

evidence_span: he is a murderer
review_note: Owner-confirmed know-frame background interpretation retained in note; no separate presupposed class. Agent-noun accusation embedded under You know; actor identity unresolved, distinct from speaker.

evidence_span: I did it, I don't understand why I did it
review_note: Background self-attribution retained (previously presupposed). Selected did-it action is presupposed by reason/understanding frame. Repeated clause retained to make evidence unique. Specific act remains unresolved.

evidence_span: I didn’t tie anyone to a stretcher.
review_note: Denial of restraint action used in execution contrast; no explicit killing predicate.

evidence_span: I didn’t pump any poison into anybody’s veins from behind a locked door.
review_note: Denied poisoning/injection action; do not silently infer death. Execution comparison in context.

evidence_span: I did not molest that kid of yours.
review_note: Owner-confirmed know-frame background interpretation retained in note; no separate presupposed class. Specified different offense; not a killing denial.

evidence_span: You are murdering me and I feel sorry for you.
review_note: Selected murdering predicate concerns execution, actor addressee; sympathy clause retained for unique evidence.

evidence_span: Go ahead Warden, murder me.
review_note: Imperative execution-as-murder contrast.

evidence_span: What happened between me and Rocky happened too fast.
review_note: Occurrence affirmed; participants are not resolved agents. Not a killing admission.

evidence_span: I don't have anything to say
review_note: Speech closure, not denial of action or knowledge.

evidence_span: you can proceed Warden Jones.
review_note: Selected proceeding action is permitted, not reported as occurring. Distinct from the asserted act of giving permission.

evidence_span: but will kill me otherwise.
review_note: Grammatical agent carries over from shackles and chains, a nonhuman rhetorical cause. Do not replace it with a specific person. Otherwise relationship remains unclear; kill is not negated by preceding cannot hold my mind.
